questions.question:
A: What do you want to be in the future?
B: I want to be a ______. I like to help sick animals.
questions.explanation: 幫助生病的動物，對應職業為獸醫 (vet)。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能分不清人醫 (doctor) 與獸醫 (vet)。

questions.question: I am going to ______ Taiwan this summer. I want to see the mountains.
questions.explanation: be going to 之後接原形動詞，參訪地點用 visit。
questions.commonMisconception: 動詞形式錯誤。

questions.question: My sister likes to cook. She wants to be a ______.
questions.explanation: 喜歡煮飯，理想職業為廚師 (chef)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 chef 這個較進階的職業單字（相對於 cook）。

questions.question:
A: What ______ you going to do tomorrow?
B: I'm going to go to the park.
questions.explanation: be going to 結構中，主詞 you 對應的 B 動詞是 are。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 tomorrow 影響誤以為要用未來式助動詞或誤選 do。

questions.question: Leo ______ going to visit his grandparents next weekend.
questions.explanation: 主詞 Leo 是單數，對應 B 動詞為 is。若選 will 則後方不應有 going to。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 will 與 be going to 的結構。

questions.question:
A: Is she going to be a singer?
B: No, she ______. She is going to be a dancer.
questions.explanation: 對 'Is she...?' 的否定簡答為 'No, she isn't'。
questions.commonMisconception: 在未來計畫的情境中誤用 won't，雖然 will 也是未來式，但結構需對應問句。

questions.question: They ______ going to move to a new house next month.
questions.explanation: 主詞 They 為複數，選用 are。
questions.commonMisconception: 主謂不一致。

questions.question: What ______ Sam want to be when he grows up?
questions.explanation: 詢問意願 'want to be' 的助動詞，配合單數 Sam 需用 does。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 'What is he going to be' 與 'What does he want to be'。

questions.question: I want to ______ a pilot and fly planes.
questions.explanation: want to 之後接原形動詞，B 動詞的原形為 be。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生習慣用 am/is/are，不熟悉 be 原形的用法。

questions.question:
Toby likes stars, so he wants to be an astronaut. Ken likes planes, so he wants to be a pilot.
Question: What does Ken want to do?
questions.explanation: Ken 想當飛行員 (pilot)，對應動作是開飛機 (fly planes)。
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取錯誤，將 Toby 與 Ken 的夢想搞混。

questions.question:
It will be sunny this Sunday. I am going to have a picnic with my family.
Question: Will it rain this Sunday?
questions.explanation: 文中預測是晴天 (sunny)，故不會下雨。未來式否定簡答為 won't。
questions.commonMisconception: 不懂 won't 是 will not 的縮寫。

questions.question:
Next year, Lily is going to move to Tainan. She wants to learn how to cook from her grandma.
Question: What is Lily's primary (主要) goal?
questions.explanation: 文本強調她想跟奶奶「學煮飯」(learn how to cook)。
questions.commonMisconception: 語意權重判斷錯誤（如誤以為重點是搬家或看奶奶）。

questions.question:
In the future, robots will help us in the kitchen. They will cook and clean.
Question: What will robots NOT do?
questions.explanation: 文中提到煮飯和清潔，並未提到寫功課 (do homework)。
questions.commonMisconception: 受生活經驗干擾而過度推論。選項中只有 homework 未提及。

questions.question:
A: Are you going to go to Kenting?
B: No. It's too expensive (太貴). I'm going to Hualien instead.
Question: Where is B going?
questions.explanation: B 否定了墾丁，並選擇去花蓮 (Hualien)。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚 B 的轉折句 instead。

questions.question: ______ is going to be a scientist. He loves science experiments.
questions.explanation: B 動詞是 is，且後方代名詞用 He，故主詞需為第三人稱單數男性名字 Leo。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 B 動詞與代名詞 He 的多重線索。

questions.question: If you want to go to Mars, you should be an ______.
questions.explanation: 去火星 (Mars) 需要的身分是太空人 (astronaut)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 Mars 或 astronaut。

questions.question: The sky is very dark. I think it ______ to rain soon.
questions.explanation: 根據現有跡象對未來的強烈預測，使用 be going to 結構。主詞 it 配 is。
questions.commonMisconception: 結構不完整（漏掉 to 或 B 動詞錯誤）。

questions.question:
A: What are you going to do this summer?
B: I'm going to America to ______ English.
questions.explanation: 去美國的目的（to 為標誌的不定詞）後加原形動詞 learn。
questions.commonMisconception: 目的狀語動詞形式混淆。

questions.question: To be a good ______ , you should be kind to patients (病人).
questions.explanation: 照顧病人是護理師 (nurse) 的職責。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識詞彙 patients。

questions.question:
The movie starts at 7:00 PM. It's 6:30 PM now. We ______ late if we don't hurry.
Question: Choose the best words.
questions.explanation: 主詞 We 配 are，加上未來預測 be going to be late。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略主謂一致或漏掉 be 動詞。

questions.question:
A: What did you do last Sunday?
B: I ______ to the beach with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句子中出現 last Sunday（上週日），表示過去發生的動作，需使用 go 的過去式 went。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能未注意到時間副詞，或不熟悉不規則動詞變化。

questions.question: We went to Taitung and ______ some delicious food there.
questions.explanation: 前半句 went 使用過去式，後半句為完成相同假期的描述，應維持過去式 ate。
questions.commonMisconception: 時態一致性（Tense Consistency）的概念薄弱。

questions.question: The weather was great, so we ______ hiking in the mountains.
questions.explanation: 從 was 可知情境為過去式，go hiking 的過去式為 went hiking。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 go hiking 固定用法或遺漏過去式轉化。

questions.question:
A: ______ you go camping last month?
B: No, I didn't. I stayed home.
questions.explanation: 詢問過去發生的動作，疑問句應使用助動詞 Did 開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 受現在式習慣影響選用 Do，或受 stays home 的動詞屬性誤導選用 B 動詞 Were。

questions.question:
A: Where ______ Leo yesterday afternoon?
B: He was in the library.
questions.explanation: 詢問「地點/狀態」且對象是單數 Leo，時間是 yesterday，需選用 B 動詞過去式 was。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆助動詞 Did 與 B 動詞 Was。

questions.question:
A: What ______ Toby and Ken do during the winter break?
B: They visited their grandma in Tainan.
questions.explanation: 描述已結束的寒假活動，助動詞使用 did。主詞為複數但 did 不分單複數。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能在複數主詞下猶豫是否要變換助動詞形式。

questions.question: I ______ at the party last night because I had a headache.
questions.explanation: 表達「不在場（狀態）」，主詞 I 對應 was，否定式為 wasn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選 didn't，忽略了後方並無原形動詞。

questions.question: We ______ many beautiful photos in the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: 動詞 take 的不規則過去式是 took。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤以為所有過去式皆加 ed (taked)。

questions.question: She didn't ______ any milk this morning.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 didn't 之後應還原為「原形動詞」。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 this morning 過去時間強烈誘導而使用 drank。

questions.question:
Last week, Amy went to Taipei. She visited Taipei 101 and ate beef noodles. 
Question: What DIDN'T Amy do in Taipei?
questions.explanation: 文中只提到 101 與牛肉麵，並未提及去海邊 (go to the beach)。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚題目中的否定詞 DIDN'T。

questions.question:
Where was the cat? It wasn't in the kitchen. It was under the bed! 
Question: Was the cat in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: 文中表明 wasn't in the kitchen，且時態為過去式。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆現在式與過去式的簡答。

questions.question:
Dear Dad, I am having fun in Japan. I saw many deer yesterday. Tomorrow I will go to Tokyo. 
Question: When did the writer see the deer?
questions.explanation: 文中明確指出 'I saw many deer yesterday'。
questions.commonMisconception: 受時態雜揉影響（am having, saw, will go），無法精確提取特定事件的時間點。

questions.question:
Leo: 'I went to a museum last Friday.' 
Sam: 'Was it interesting?' 
Leo: 'No, it was boring.' 
Question: How did Leo feel about the museum?
questions.explanation: boring（無聊）對應的感受是「不感興趣」。
questions.commonMisconception: 不熟悉有趣 (interesting) 與無聊 (boring) 的反義對應。

questions.question:
It rained every day during our trip to Kenting. We stayed in the hotel and played cards. 
Question: Why didn't they go swimming?
questions.explanation: 文中提到下雨（rained every day），推論因天氣不好故待在室內玩牌。
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏因果推論能力，直接選了文本中有出現的 activity (liked cards) 作為原因。

questions.question: Two years ago, many ______ lived in this small forest.
questions.explanation: wolf 的複數不規則變化為 wolves。
questions.commonMisconception: 不規則複數變化規則混淆。

questions.question: You should ______ many questions when you visit the Science Museum.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 should 之後應接原形動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 visit 影響或誤以為描述狀況而變更動詞形式。

questions.question: Last Chinese New Year, we ______ red envelopes from our grandparents.
questions.explanation: 描述去年的春節活動，使用 get 的過去式 got。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 red envelopes 的文化脈絡，或是時態抓取錯誤。

questions.question: The ______ was in June last year. We saw a race on the river.
questions.explanation: 六月份且有河上競賽（race on the river），對應端午節（Dragon Boat Festival）。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備節慶日期與習俗的英文化對應能力。

questions.question: On Halloween, the kids ______ 'Trick or treat!' and got many candies.
questions.explanation: 描述萬聖節當時的動作且後方 got 為過去式，故使用 said。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選 say，忽視敘事時態一致性。

questions.question:
In summer, I went to the beach. In winter, I went to the mountains. 
Question: How many seasons are mentioned (提及)?
questions.explanation: 文中提及 summer（夏季）與 winter（冬季），共兩個季節。
questions.commonMisconception: 讀數目錯誤或不認識 season 這個單字。

questions.question: The ______ is a famous tower in Paris, France.
questions.explanation: 艾非爾鐵塔 (Eiffel Tower) 位於巴黎。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能不清楚世界各大地標的對應城市。

questions.question: People in Japan often eat ______. It's made of rice and fish.
questions.explanation: 由米和魚組成的日本代表性食物是壽司 (sushi)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不熟悉各國飲食文化單字。

questions.question: My friends and I ______ to music every day. We love pop songs.
questions.explanation: 主詞 My friends and I 為複數，接原形動詞 listen。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣口語忽略 listen 之後通常要加 to，但在這題選項中只需選動詞形態。

questions.question:
A: What ______ you doing last night?
B: I was doing my English homework.
questions.explanation: 過去進行式疑問句，主詞 you 配 were。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆助動詞 Did 與 B 動詞 Were。

questions.question:
A: Is your father going to watch the game tonight?
B: Yes, ______.
questions.explanation: 主詞 your father 是男性，代名詞用 he，B 動詞對應為 is。
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞選錯 gender。

questions.question:
A: Do you like to go shopping?
B: No. I ______ it's boring.
questions.explanation: 一般現在式的意見表達，主詞 I 配 think。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 B 的不喜歡影響誤以為要用過去式 thought。

questions.question: In America, students ______ a yellow bus to school.
questions.explanation: 描述一般的習慣或事實，使用現在簡單式，主詞 students 為複數故用 take。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 yellow bus 吸引而忘記動詞與主詞 students 的對應。

questions.question: Lily's uncle ______ to be a pilot when he was young.
questions.explanation: 後半句 when he was young 指出是過去的事，故動詞使用 wanted。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選現在式單三 wants，未讀完後半句線索。

questions.question: We went to a Japanese restaurant ______.
questions.explanation: went 為過去式，時間副詞應選 last night。
questions.commonMisconception: 動詞時態與時間副詞未對應。

questions.question:
Max: 'I am going to New York.' 
Eva: 'I am going to London.' 
Question: Where is Max going?
questions.explanation: New York 位於 USA（美國）。
questions.commonMisconception: 地名與國家名的地理連結力弱。

questions.question:
I play games with my friends on Fridays. I play piano on Saturdays. Today is the first day of the weekend.
Question: What am I doing today?
questions.explanation: 週末的第一天通常指週六 (Saturday)，對應活動為 play piano。
questions.commonMisconception: 文化差異認知（週末首日是週六還是週日），在此語境中指週六。

questions.question:
Menu: Beef Noodles $120, Pizza $150, Sushi $200. 
I have $130. What can I NOT buy?
questions.explanation: 持有 130 元，買不起 200 元的壽司和 150 元的披薩，選項中 Sushi 符合題目。注意問的是 NOT。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 NOT 或是數學計算錯誤。

questions.question:
Happy 11th Birthday, Ken! I hope you like the robot I bought for you yesterday. 
Question: How old is Ken today?
questions.explanation: Happy 11th Birthday 指的是 11 歲生日。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 11th 序數詞干擾或受 yesterday 影響。

questions.question:
In some countries, you should not ______ with your fingers. You should use a fork or chopsticks. 
Question: Choose the best words.
questions.explanation: 配餐具（叉子、筷子）的動作是吃 (eat)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備詞義關聯推論能力。

questions.question: My cake is big, but your cake is ______ than mine.
questions.explanation: 有 than 出現需用比較級，big 的比較級為 bigger。
questions.commonMisconception: 比較級重複字尾規則不熟。

questions.question: When it is Christmas in Taiwan, the weather is cold. Because it is ______.
questions.explanation: 聖誕節在十二月，季節為冬季 (winter)。
questions.commonMisconception: 月份與季節對應發生錯誤。

questions.question: Next year, I ______ study harder to get good grades.
questions.explanation: Next year 表示未來，助動詞用 will。若選 am 後面需有 going to。
questions.commonMisconception: 未來式結構混淆。

questions.question: In Chinese culture, ______ is a lucky color for Lunar New Year.
questions.explanation: 中國文化中，紅包與新年裝飾常以紅色 (red) 代表幸運。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備跨文化基礎常識。

questions.question: People in ______ speak English as their first language.
questions.explanation: 加拿大 (Canada) 的主要官方語言之一是英語。
questions.commonMisconception: 國家與官方語言對應知識不足。

questions.question:
A: Look! I got the gold medal in the race.
B: Wow! You are so fast.
Question: What color is the medal?
questions.explanation: 金牌 (gold medal) 是金黃色的 (yellow/gold)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 gold 或是顏色連結錯誤。

questions.question:
A: What do you like to do in your free time?
B: I like to ______ sports with my friends. It's fun!
questions.explanation: 動詞搭配詞習慣（Collocation），進行球類運動或團隊競技運動時使用 play。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能受中文影響選用 go 或 watch，或是選用 V-ing 形式 reading。

questions.question: Leo is very quiet. He likes to ______ comic books in the library.
questions.explanation: 閱讀漫畫書的動作為 read。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能受圖書館安靜氛圍影響誤選其他靜態動詞。

questions.question: Amy loves music. She can ______ the piano very well.
questions.explanation: 彈奏樂器（鋼琴）固定搭配動詞 play。
questions.commonMisconception: 可能與 listen to 混淆（聽音樂 vs 彈樂器）。

questions.question:
A: What ______ your brother like to do?
B: He likes to go swimming.
questions.explanation: 第三人稱單數主詞 your brother 的助動詞應使用 does。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生常受 A 問句影響習慣性選 do，或誤用 B 動詞 is。

questions.question: My sisters ______ to watch TV after they finish their homework.
questions.explanation: 主詞 My sisters 為複數，動詞 like 不需加 s。
questions.commonMisconception: 受「第三人稱單數加 s」規則干擾，未注意主詞為複數。

questions.question:
A: Does Lily like to paint pictures?
B: Yes, she ______. She wants to be an artist.
questions.explanation: 用 Does 開頭的疑問句，簡答時需對應使用 does。
questions.commonMisconception: 簡答時混淆助動詞與 B 動詞。

questions.question: I don't like to play basketball, ______ I like to go jogging in the park.
questions.explanation: 前後兩句為語意轉折關係（不喜歡 A 但喜歡 B），連接詞使用 but。
questions.commonMisconception: 語意連接邏輯不清。

questions.question: Sam likes to ______ stamps. He has a big box of them.
questions.explanation: like to 之後接原形動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 與 like + V-ing 混淆，在此結構中 to 為不定詞符號。

questions.question: Neither Toby nor his friends ______ to play computer games today.
questions.explanation: Neither...nor... 結構動詞需依靠近的主詞（his friends 複數）決定，故選 want。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 Toby 影響誤選單數動詞。

questions.question:
Ben likes to play soccer. Cindy likes to play the violin. Danny likes to go hiking. 
Question: Who likes a musical hobby?
questions.explanation: Cindy 彈小提琴（violin），屬於音樂類嗜好。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能不認識 violin 或不知道其分類。

questions.question:
It is raining outside. We can't play basketball. Tina likes to read. Sam likes to watch movies.
Question: Where are they most likely?
questions.explanation: 下雨且看板上的活動（看電影、閱讀）推論是在室內/家裡。
questions.commonMisconception: 受第一句下雨影響而分心，未能與後續活動連結地點。

questions.question: I like to go swimming on Mondays. I like to play chess on Wednesdays. Today is Tuesday. What will I probably do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 今天週二，明天（tomorrow）是週三，對應活動是 play chess。
questions.commonMisconception: 日期推算錯誤（明天 vs 後天）或活動對應錯誤。

questions.question:
My brother likes to play sports, but I like to stay home and read. 
Question: What is different between them?
questions.explanation: 句子描述的是「運動」與「待在家閱讀」的差異，屬於嗜好（hobbies）。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能不懂 hobbies 的意思。

questions.question:
A: Do you want to join the Art Club?
B: I like to draw, but I don't have free time on Fridays. 
Question: Why might B NOT join?
questions.explanation: B 提到週五沒有空（don't have free time），語意對應忙碌（busy）。
questions.commonMisconception: 受前半句「喜歡畫畫」影響而忽略後半句的轉折條件。

questions.question: My father usually likes to read the news, but now he ______ a movie.
questions.explanation: 前面是習慣用現在簡單式，後面提到 but now 應改用現在進行式描述當前動作。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 habit 語意干擾持續使用現在式。

questions.question: Mark wants to be healthy. He should ______ more often.
questions.explanation: 追求健康，慢跑（go jogging）是最合理的嗜好建議。
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯常識判斷錯誤。

questions.question: Our school band needs a drummer. Who should join?
options: Someone who likes to play the drums
questions.explanation: 校園樂團需要鼓手（drummer），應找喜歡打鼓（play the drums）的人。
questions.commonMisconception: 關鍵字 drummer 與 play the drums 的詞類轉化對應能力不足。

questions.question: In the UK, people often like to ______ tea and eat cakes in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 搭配詞習慣：喝茶使用 drink。
questions.commonMisconception: 中文習慣說「吃」下午茶，可能誤選 eat。

questions.question:
A: Where does she like to go on weekends?
B: She likes to go to the night market to ______ street food.
questions.explanation: go to... to [動詞原形] 表示目的，故選 eat。
questions.commonMisconception: 動詞形式錯誤。

questions.question:
Sam and Leo both like to play soccer. They are on the same team. 
Question: What can we know about them?
options: They go to the same school.
questions.explanation: 兩人都喜歡踢足球，表示擁有相同的愛好。
questions.commonMisconception: 推理過度（如：一定在同校或是兄弟）。
